about.title: Our story
about.subtitle: Small beginnings. Lasting values.
about.intro: Jamal Al-Din Abu Aitah & Sons for Trade and Industry was founded in 2011. Our first factory measured just 100 square metres and processed up to 600 litres of fresh milk daily.
about.growth: In 2015, we expanded to more than 500 square metres, processing over 3,000 litres a day. In 2017, a new 1,500-square-metre factory was built with specialist engineers and modern equipment, raising capacity to more than 5,000 litres daily.
about.quality: In 2019, the company received ISO 22000 certification. Our story is one of investing in local food, the people who make it, and the community that shares it.
about.goal: To strengthen the value of Palestinian products by making high-quality local food that can compete with imported alternatives.
about.team: The original company profile describes a team of 30 factory workers across production lines and a fleet of around 10 refrigerated vehicles delivering products to the local market.

events.title: News & events
events.subtitle: Connected to our community.
events.rayebText: From the original news archive: a look at the minerals and vitamins in dairy, and its place in everyday meals.
events.exhibitionText: We were proud to take part alongside Palestinian companies, sharing local products and meeting our community.
events.visitText: The company welcomed a delegation from Jabalia Al-Nazla Municipality, including the mayor and his deputy.
events.article: The 2021 Palestinian Industries Exhibition brought local producers and visitors together to discover Palestinian-made products. The company took part in the exhibition with other national businesses, introducing its products and supporting local industry.
events.articleMore: The original report highlighted the importance of promoting Palestinian products, building their competitiveness, and strengthening partnerships with the private sector. The exhibition offered an opportunity to meet producers and experience the quality of locally made food.
